senses.gloss:
√sku 'tear'
present: [2.] skautí -- [5.] skunoti skunute -- [9.] skunāti skunīte 
[perfect: cuskāva cuskuve acuskavat askauṣīt askoṣṭa skoṣyati skoṣyate skotā ]
verbal: skuta -skā́vam 
secondary: passive: skūyáte -- intensive: coṣkūyáte etc. -- desiderative: cuskūṣa- -- causative: skāvayati 
derivatives: -skava -skavana S. 
The doubtful form skuptvā in Ap. Dh. S. (i. 31. 24) perhaps belongs here; compare dantaskavana ib. ii. 5. 9.
